placements.title: Capability is real only once it has been rehearsed
placements.frame: Does this expression establish, reinforce, or operationalize the claim that a capability only counts as real once it has been practiced under a defined, owned cadence?
placements.why: src-2 states the organizing principle explicitly — an unrehearsed rollback is treated as one the org does not actually have, equating capability with demonstrated practice rather than mere existence. src-1 enacts that principle by mandating a monthly cadence going forward; src-3 and src-4 are the structured record fields (Cadence, Owner) that operationalize it — naming who is accountable for keeping the rehearsal current. All four converge on one recurring, future-feeding subject: readiness as something proven through rehearsal rather than assumed, which is exactly the kind of theme later envelopes (drill results, cadence changes, ownership transfers, other systems' rehearsal programs) would keep feeding. The graph and strata are both empty for this repo, so there is no existing leaf or category to reuse, and no hub or strata parent yet exists to place this under — it stands as the first, foundational node on this subject.
